name: United Arab Emirates
intro: Experience a futuristic oasis where heritage meets architectural marvels. From the soaring heights of the Burj Khalifa to luxury desert camps under the stars, Dubai is a playground of modern global luxury.
weather: Hot desert climate. Pleasant warm winters (20°C to 30°C), scorching dry summers (40°C+) where indoor malls are preferred.
visaInfo: Visa required prior to travel for Indian passport holders (obtainable as eVisa).
flightDuration: Approx 3-4 hours direct flight from Mumbai or Delhi.
highlights: Ascend the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa
Embark on a vintage 4x4 desert safari over golden dunes
Discover the luxurious resorts on the palm-shaped island of Palm Jumeirah
Shop at the massive Dubai Mall and watch the choreographed fountain shows
